caption: The drawing depicts a puppet dressed in a black robe with long sleeves and what appear to be pale hands emerging from the sleeve ends. The puppet's head is large and features a white, shoulder-length wig, styled in a traditional judge or barrister fashion, with painted facial features including black eyebrows, black eyes, a slightly pointed pink nose, and a red mouth. Around the neck, there is a white collar and a cravat-like neckcloth. To the right of the main frontal puppet figure, there is a smaller side view of the puppet's head and collar, showing the roundness of the head and detailing the wig’s shape. The background of the drawing is a plain, light beige color.
title: Judge Hand Puppet
